acceptance: Revisit when any run has sum_ratio above 1.25 at a speed factor within 0.1 of 1.0, or any block occurs; record ratio, delta, speed factor and whether the slowdown was real
Thresholds stay as they are until then
context: Report recorded when ci-fast-duration-gate-false-block-review-20261027 was closed on 2026-10-31 (59 verdicts from merged PRs 3760-3853). Recommendation then: keep both thresholds, do not roll back to report mode.
description: Of 59 measured post-flip verdicts none blocked, but 15 ran on runners with a speed factor of 1.5 or more (up to 1.95), and 8 had a sum ratio above 1.20 (max 1.282 against the 1.30 limit). 7 of 59 exceeded the 360 s delta term alone, all slow-runner noise that the ratio term absorbed. A real slowdown on a slow runner could land just under the limit, and normal noise on a slow runner could land just over it.
